scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.db:migrate: cat db/migrations/*.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U pickup -d pickup
scripts.db:seed: cat db/seeds/*.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U pickup -d pickup
scripts.db:test:reset: npm run db:test:up && docker compose exec -T postgres_test psql -U pickup -d pickup_test -c "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"
scripts.db:test:migrate: cat db/migrations/*.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres_test psql -U pickup -d pickup_test
scripts.db:test:seed: cat db/seeds/*.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres_test psql -U pickup -d pickup_test
scripts.db:test:prepare: npm run db:test:reset && npm run db:test:migrate && npm run db:test:seed
